data.name: Mirielle
data.gender_notes: Mirielle is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name Mariel, meaning 'rebellious', which was later transformed to 'My Delight is God' in Christian tradition. This name was borne by several saints, including a fifth-century virgin martyr and a tenth-century French abbess. The name Mirielle carries the meaning “My Delight is God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Mirielle usually hope their child will grow to embody my delight is god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name reflecting devotion to God.
data.etymology: Mirielle belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “My Delight is God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mirielle total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: מיריאל
in_hebrew.meaning: מיריאל - אלוהים הוא אור, האור שלי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מיריאל הוא שם שמקורו במילים העבריות 'מיר' ו'אל', שמשמעותן 'אור האלוהים' או 'האור שלי'. השם מורכב מ'מיר', שיכול להיות קשור למילה 'מר', שפירושה 'מרירות' או 'אור', ומ'אל', שפירושה 'אלוהים'. השם נמצא בשימוש במסורות נוצריות ויהודיות כאחד, ומשמש כזכרון לאור ולחסד של אלוהים.

in_greek.name: Μιριέλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Μιριέλ προέρχεται από τις εβραϊκές λέξεις 'מיר' και 'אל', που σημαίνει 'φως του Θεού' ή 'το φως μου'. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Μιριέλ συμβολίζει το φως και τη χάρη του Θεού. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, παρόμοια ονόματα συνδέονται με την έννοια του φωτός ως σύμβολο της πνευματικής αναγέννησης.

in_latin.name: Mirielle
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Mirielle derivatur ex vocibus hebraicis 'מיר' et 'אל', quae significant 'lux Dei' seu 'mea lux'. In traditione christiana, nomen Mirielle refertur ad lucem et gratiam Dei. In Ecclesia primitiva, nomina similium vocum associata sunt notionem lucis ut symbolum renovationis spiritualis.

in_english.name: Mirielle
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mirielle originates from Hebrew roots 'מיר' (mir) and 'אל' (El), meaning 'God's light' or 'my light'. It symbolizes the divine light and grace of God. In Christian tradition, Mirielle is associated with illumination and spiritual awakening. Historically, names with similar etymology have been used to signify the presence of God in one's life. Today, Mirielle is used across various Christian cultures, signifying hope, guidance, and divine love.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mirielle holds a significant cultural impact in the French-speaking world. It was popularized by the French author, Marcel Pagnol, who dedicated a trilogy of novels and films to a character named Mirielle. This character, who embodies the free-spirited and independent nature of the name, has influenced the way Mirielle is perceived in popular culture, particularly in France.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Mirielle lies in its transformation from the Hebrew Mariel, meaning 'rebellious', to 'My Delight is God'. This transformation reflects the idea that even those who may have rebellious or challenging natures can find true delight and fulfillment in their relationship with God. The name Mirielle also carries the legacy of the various saints named Mirielle, who lived lives of deep faith and devotion, inspiring others to seek a closer connection with God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Mirielle: Radiant and Adored One, reflecting God's light and love.

It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.
